summary: Premium adds Fast play to Tower Defense, so players with a strong tower can spend less time waiting for waves they already know they will win.

features.title: Game speed
features.short: Run the game up to ten times faster
features.description: Choose a speed from normal to ten times faster during a wave. The simulation uses the same steps and scoring; slower devices may run below the selected speed to stay responsive.

features.title: Automatic waves
features.short: Let waves follow one another by themselves
features.description: Pick "After wave N" in the wave list to start successive waves automatically, up to your existing record; the first option, Intermediate stop, opens the shop after every wave. At the chosen wave the shop opens and speed returns to normal for this run. Controls remain available during waves.

features.title: Saved Fast play settings
features.short: Keep your preferred setup for new games
features.description: A save button appears when you change the speed or the stopping wave. Press it to remember that setup in this browser; new games use it, and changes during a run do not replace it until you save again.

features.title: Owner switch
features.short: Turn Fast play on or off for players
features.description: The owner of the server decides from the game's window in the desktop whether players get Fast play. It is on by default.
